members.cluster_pick_reason: #2215 covers the same trailing-slash fix as #2214 but also corrects a downstream bug in `shouldAttemptFallback`: after normalizing to `''`, the guard `pathname === '/'` in #2214's version would never match, causing root-path discovery to attempt an unnecessary fallback. #2215 fixes this by checking `pathname === ''` and extracts a shared `normalizeDiscoveryPath` helper to keep both call sites consistent.
